facts.fact: The Startup Bill, 2022 (Senate Bills No. 14) was published in Kenya Gazette Supplement No. 207 of 30 December 2022 for introduction in the Senate, providing for a registrar of startups, certified incubators, an optional credit guarantee scheme and fiscal incentives.
The bill's memorandum of objects and reasons states that there is currently no regulatory framework for startups in Kenya.

systems.owner: Senate of Kenya; Kenya National Innovation Agency as registrar
